bifrost: bifrost_app::intents (App Intents on the control socket), springboard/src/svc.rs (audio service client, re-exported as bifrost_app::audio), springboard/audiod (audio service), springboard/src/shell/music (lock-screen and Control Center now-playing), springboard/ui/src/media_search.rs (audio search request model and catalogue matching)
summary: Media Intents is the Siri audio search and playback type set (AudioSearch) that Apple delivers through App Intents. BifrOSt has the App Intents side (typed intents and entity queries, no Siri or voice), a per-app audio playback service with shell now-playing controls, and a pure model of the search request, its criteria and catalogue matching (springboard/ui/src/media_search.rs). Nothing routes requests from the system to apps, and there is no voice path.

features.feature: Audio search and playback requests from Siri
features.apple: Responding to audio search and playback requests (Siri, AudioSearch)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-12, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No AudioSearch type, no Siri, no voice dialog; intents are called as JSON over the control socket and the dialog text is not spoken

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Criteria cases mirror the official enum; the request is built from request text or a link. No media fields (artist, album, genre, mood, media type) and no spotlight search results input

features.feature: Resolving free-text media requests to app results
features.apple: AudioSearch values(for:) through the intent value query (the system delivers the search type to App Intents)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. values_for matches every content word against title, artist and album with the fuzzy matcher and ranks by score; it is a library call, not a system-delivered search, and the shell does not resolve parameters (Spotlight runs parameterless shortcuts only, docs/bifrost-ui.md:966-973)

features.feature: Audio content entities (song, album, artist, episode)
features.apple: Audio domain entity schemas (song, album, artist, podcast episode) for App Intents
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Four kinds with title, artist and album; no schema declared to the system and no duration, artwork or playback URL fields

features.apple: Playback that Siri requests start in the app (Media Intents results point to playable media)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/svc.rs (pub mod audio, client), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service), springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/engine.rs, springboard/ui/src/media_queue.rs (PlaybackQueue), springboard/sdk/src/media_intents.rs (handle_request); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-28.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-28.rs
features.note: Playback is a shared service that survives app restarts, and bifrost_app::audio is the client. bifrost_app::media_intents now gives apps the media item, playback request and play queue types, and handle_request applies a request to the queue and returns its dialog; play, queue, search, advance and the end of the queue are tested headless. Gap: the queue is not yet handed to the audio service as a playlist, and a voice request reaching the app needs Midget.

features.feature: Now-playing state shown outside the app
features.apple: Not in Media Intents itself (Now Playing and lock-screen controls are separate Apple APIs)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/now_playing.rs (publish_body, accept, command_from_event); springboard/src/shell/services/now_playing.rs (parse_session, the now_playing service); springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/nowplaying.rs
features.note: Apps publish their session (content, playback, declared commands) through bifrost_app::now_playing, and the shell reads it back; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-11.rs. Gap: artwork does not reach the shell yet, and the card and the Control Center tile are drawn only on the lab machine.

features.feature: Discovering intents without launching the app
features.apple: Intents surfaced to the system for Siri and Shortcuts
features.note: Spotlight lists manifest [[intent]] entries with shortcut = true and no required parameter, and the transport intents are listed the same way. The listing rules and the manifest reader are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs. No Siri or Shortcuts-app listing.

features.apple: Siri voice responses and dialogs for media requests
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-12, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. IntentResult dialog is returned to the caller and logged on failure, never spoken or shown by Spotlight

gaps: No system delivery of audio search requests and no Siri or voice request path for media (springboard/ui/src/media_search.rs models the request, but nothing routes system requests to apps).
AudioSearch.Criteria has no media fields (genre, mood, media type); only search text, unspecified and link are modelled.
No parameter resolution, disambiguation or confirmation for media intents (requestDisambiguation, requestConfirmation are not modelled, docs/bifrost-ui.md:966-973).
No SDK call for an app to publish media metadata or a queue to the shell or to voice requests; Music and Podcasts keep their own state.
Intents are served only while the app runs (docs/bifrost-ui.md:980); Apple media requests can launch and play without an open window.
